status: Checked 27 Oct 2026 (owner asked Claude to do it): Wikipedia's Edinburgh and Glasgow airlines-and-destinations tables, then Google Flights direct-only searches for Wed 13 Jan and Wed 10 Feb 2027 (which also show the nearest days with direct flights). Winter frequencies are estimates from those searches, not timetables. Re-check each autumn.
rule: Spec: drive time to the nearest airport with YEAR-ROUND direct flights from Edinburgh (EDI) or Glasgow (GLA). 'year_round' counts in full; 'seasonal' counts much less in winter; 'none' or 'unknown' don't count until confirmed. The score page lets the user choose: year-round direct only, seasonal direct counted at reduced credit, or flights ignored (owner, 25 Oct 2026). Owner, 27 Oct 2026: both EDI and GLA count (routes are similar; the choice is by flight times). Year-round means direct flights every month November-March, at least about twice a week, because trips range from a few days at short notice to a couple of months.
